title: Málaga, Andalusia — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Málaga, Andalusia: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Málaga is a city in Andalusia with a population of 578,000. The birthplace of Picasso on the Costa del Sol, with a vibrant port, Alcazaba fortress, and year-round Mediterranean sunshine. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 300 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
